name: @shadcn/lint
summary: Agent-first linter that enforces Tailwind design system rules and hands coding agents fixes from your theme.
description: An ESLint and Oxlint plugin that turns a Tailwind v4 design system into lint rules agents can verify, with 6 rules covering className restyling, raw colors, arbitrary values, inline styles, unknown classes and unreadable static classes. When an agent breaks a rule, the error explains what's wrong and suggests a fix based on your components, variants and theme, with custom messages, placeholders and per-component contracts. Works with React, Vue and Svelte, with or without shadcn/ui.
contains: 6 rules: no-restyle, no-raw-colors, no-arbitrary-values, no-inline-styles, no-unknown-classes, require-static-classes
works with ESLint 9.30+ and Oxlint 1.80+, Node.js 20.19+
Tailwind v4 projects; shadcn/ui not required
custom error messages, placeholders and per-component contracts
settings.shadcn: component imports, class functions, theme token imports
eval: 150+ agent task runs; most tasks to zero violations in one correction round
monorepo support for shared component packages
